The earliest Blue Plaque that has been awarded to one of the nine artists who formed the **Group X** exhibition at the Mansard Gallery was given to **Percy Wyndham Lewis** in **1983**.  

- **Percy Wyndham Lewis** – plaque erected **1983** by Greater London Council at 61 Palace Gardens Terrace, Kensington, London (Blue Plaques website, “Lewis, Percy Wyndham (1882‑1957)”, plaque erected 1983).  

No earlier Blue Plaques can be found for any of the other Group X members (Arthur Dismorr, Frederick Etchells, Randolph Hamilton, Robert Roberts, W.H. Wadsworth, T. W. Dobson, John Ginner, or E. McKnight Kauffer) based on the information that has been retrieved.  Therefore, **1983** is the first year in which any Group X artist received a Blue Plaque in London.

steps.text:
The earliest Blue Plaque that has been awarded to one of the nine artists who formed the **Group X** exhibition at the Mansard Gallery was given to **Percy Wyndham Lewis** in **1983**.  

- **Percy Wyndham Lewis** – plaque erected **1983** by Greater London Council at 61 Palace Gardens Terrace, Kensington, London (Blue Plaques website, “Lewis, Percy Wyndham (1882‑1957)”, plaque erected 1983).  

No earlier Blue Plaques can be found for any of the other Group X members (Arthur Dismorr, Frederick Etchells, Randolph Hamilton, Robert Roberts, W.H. Wadsworth, T. W. Dobson, John Ginner, or E. McKnight Kauffer) based on the information that has been retrieved.  Therefore, **1983** is the first year in which any Group X artist received a Blue Plaque in London.
